description: This file defines an abstract base class 'Renderer' within the PdfSharp.Charting.Renderers namespace, which serves as a foundation for various renderer classes used in PDF chart rendering. It includes a constructor, virtual methods for initialization and formatting, and an abstract draw method, along with a protected field for renderer parameters.

classes.name: Renderer
classes.description: Abstract base class for all renderer classes related to PDF chart rendering.

methods.name: Renderer
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the renderer with specified parameters.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Allows derived classes to return renderer-specific initialization info.

methods.name: Format
methods.description: Calculates layout and space for drawing; can be overridden.

methods.name: Draw
methods.description: Abstract method that must be implemented to perform the rendering.
